text:
maria: Quick heads-up — target cut for the next patch is tomorrow 17:00 PT. Need final sign-offs on version bump, changelog, and any late cherry-picks. Branch: release/0.23.x. Cutoff for cherry-picks: 16:00 PT.

devon: on changelog scrub. I'll merge any small docs fixes into the changelog PR by 15:30 PT. If something larger shows up, I'll call it out here.

ryan: QA — can we get a 20m smoke window right after canary? I can do 17:20-17:40 PT. Need confirmation of smoke list + env.

maria: @ryan good. Smoke list is the usual: login, inference latency sanity, key API routes, embeddings indexing. I'll paste the minimal checklist below.

maria: ```
SMOKE CHECKS:
- auth/login flow
- /v1/generate basic prompt
- /v1/embeddings small batch
- latency < 200ms p50 on canary
- no obvious memory growth in pods
```

qa-jen: I'll own regression. I'll run the checklist and a small random sample of long-context prompts. Ping me in this thread when canary is up, I can do quick traces.

sam: Heads-up — feature-flag toggles landed in the release branch (PR #978). They touch routing, so security asked for a quick dependency scan.

sec-bot: Security scan summary: dependency-scan passed. SAST flagged one low-severity issue in middleware (file: router/validation.go). Ticket created: SEC-412. No blocker for patch if triaged before cutoff.

maria: Ok, gate: if SEC-412 is triaged and assigned before 16:00 PT we proceed. If not, we will exclude the flag change and cut a follow-up. @devon please prepare a rollback patch just in case.

devon: Will do — creating a hotfix branch that reverts the flag commit. Command I used to tag locally: ```git checkout release/0.23.x && git tag -a v0.23.1 -m "v0.23.1" && git push origin release/0.23.x && git push origin --tags```

maria: Thanks. Also quick docs check: small API param rename in the changelog — docs team needs to confirm the snippet. @devon did you add the doc diff to the changelog PR?

devon: Yup, linked the doc patch in the changelog PR and pinged docs. If they don't ack by 15:30 I'll cut a minimal note in the release notes and follow up post-ship.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-18T17:15:00-07:00 (canary on 2 nodes, 5% traffic). Smoke window requested 17:20-17:40 PT.

ryan: I'll be on standby for the smoke window. If anything fails, I'll post logs and we can either rollback or pause traffic.

maria: Final asks: everyone listed above — please confirm ownership: changelog (devon), docs ack (docs team), QA smoke (qa-jen + ryan), security triage (sec team). Reply with a quick ack or :thumbsup:.

devon: :thumbsup: changelog done.

qa-jen: :thumbsup: will run smoke + regression.

sam: :thumbsup: feature-flag monitor ready; rollback branch prepped.

sec-bot: SEC-412 assigned to @alex (sec) — triage scheduled by 15:45 PT.

maria: Perfect. If anything shifts, update this thread. Otherwise plan is cut -> canary -> smoke -> ramp. I'll post final cut call at 16:10 PT. :rocket:
